item.title: Tom Green County Clerk Sued Over Rear-End Crash
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A San Angelo woman is suing Tom Green County Clerk Christina Ubando and Isaias Jimenez for damages exceeding $100,000, alleging negligence in a February 2024 rear-end collision that caused severe injuries. Maria Lopez filed the lawsuit Jan. 7 in Tom Green County Court at Law, claiming Jimenez rear-ended the 2007 Hyundai Tucson in which she was a passenger as it slowed in the 800 block of Spaulding Street around 1:28 p.m. Feb. 27, 2024. Learn More Here.

item.title: Massive 5th Inning Lifts No. 9 Angelo State Over No. 4 UT Tyler
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A six-run fifth inning and a strong performance on the mound lifted No. 9 Angelo State to a 7-2 win over No. 4 UT Tyler on Friday afternoon at Foster Field in the 2026 home opener.With the victory, the Rams improved to 3-1 overall and in Lone Star Conference play. Learn More Here.

item.title: Retired San Angelo K-9 Vader, Who Played Role in 285 Arrests, Has Passed Away
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Retired K-9 Officer Vader, a dual-purpose patrol dog who helped seize large quantities of drugs and assisted in hundreds of arrests during his service with the San Angelo Police Department, has died. He was laid to rest Feb. 6, 2026. Learn More Here.

item.title: Update: Fatal Shooting in San Angelo — Teens Were Recklessly Handling Gun, Police Say
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — An 18-year-old man died after being shot when two teens recklessly handled a handgun inside a Windmill Apartments unit, San Angelo police said Saturday. Preliminary investigation shows that 19-year-old Norberto Gonzales and 18-year-old Jordan DeLaCruz were handling the firearm when it discharged, striking DeLaCruz, according to a news release from the San Angelo Police Department. Learn More Here.

item.title: Court Documents Reveal Dangerous Game That Led to Fatal Shooting
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Official court documents reveal that a dangerous game led to the shooting death of 18-year-old Jordan DeLaCruz.Norberto Gonzales, 19, of San Angelo, was arrested by the San Angelo Police Department for manslaughter following a fatal shooting. Learn More Here.

item.title: Four Central Bobcats Sign to Play at the Next Level
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Saturday was a big day for the Central Bobcats football team as four players signed to play at the next level. Surrounded by family, friends, coaches and teammates, Mason Van Sickle, Colton Hill, Jaekob Jackson and Jimmy Edwards all put pen to paper to make their decision on where they would be playing their college football for the next four years. Learn More Here.
